description: Defines the LimitsConfig interface and related configuration values for Ditto services, specifying limits such as max sizes and pagination defaults.

classes.name: LimitsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve configuration limits for Ditto services.

classes.name: LimitsConfig.LimitsConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining known configuration path expressions and default values for LimitsConfig.

classes.name: LimitsConfig.LimitsConfigValue.Constants
classes.description: Contains default constant values used in LimitsConfig, such as default entity size and search path.

methods.name: getHeadersMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of Ditto headers in bytes.

methods.name: getAuthSubjectsMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of authorization subjects in Ditto headers.

methods.name: getThingsMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of 'Thing' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getPoliciesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of 'Policies' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getMessagesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of 'Messages' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getThingsSearchDefaultPageSize
methods.description: Returns the default pagination size for 'things-search'.

methods.name: getThingsSearchMaxPageSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pagination size for 'things-search'.
